verdict.rationale: Versioning is evidenced: llms.txt lists separate v2 (668 pages) and v0 (529 pages) documentation sets, and doc URLs are namespaced under /v2/ and /_llms/v1/. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guidance. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, sunset/notice timelines, version-migration guides, and independent corroboration of version stability.
